entities.name: Generic message container
entities.description: A type 6 information element used to encapsulate application messages transferred between the UE and the network. It contains an IEI, length field, and the actual container contents.

entities.name: Generic message container IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier field occupying octet 1 of the generic message container.

entities.name: Length of generic message container contents
entities.description: Length field occupying octets 2-4, indicating the length of the container contents in octets.

entities.name: Generic message container contents
entities.description: Container contents field occupying octets 4 to n, with a maximum size of 65535 octets. The coding is application-dependent.

entities.name: Application-dependent coding
entities.description: The coding of the generic message container contents depends on the particular application using the container.

relations.description: The generic message container includes the IEI field as its first component.
The generic message container includes the length field to indicate the size of the contents.
The generic message container includes the contents field which holds the application message.
The coding of the container contents is guarded by the condition that it depends on the particular application.
